sloka: नगर उपवनम् गत्वा यथा स्म रमते पुरा ।तथैव रमते सीता निर्जनेषु वनेष्व् अपि ॥२-६०-९॥
transliteration: nagara upavanam gatvā yathā sma ramate purā ।tathaiva ramate sītā nirjaneṣu vaneṣv api ॥2-60-9॥

translations.english: Earlier, just as Sita used to revel in the gardens of the city, so does she now in those desolate forests.
